name: Bento Story Grid
description: Responsive bento grid of story cards with a full-width featured card followed by two-up and three-up rows, each with image, tag, title and date, revealing on scroll.
contents: Featured hero card with image beside text
Grid of story cards with image, tag, title and date
behavior: Non-featured cards slide up and fade in when scrolled into view
Card images scale slightly on hover
Reveal animation is skipped when reduced motion is preferred
Grid goes from one column on mobile to two on tablet to twelve on desktop
editableByProps: Title, cards, images, links, tags and dates
Grid column classes, gap and minimum card height

needsCodeEdit.change: Change which cards span which columns
needsCodeEdit.where: columnSpanClass constant inside the cardsData map
heightClass constant inside the cardsData map

fixed: Only the first card should be marked isHero, it spans the full width
Cards at index 1 to 4 span half the desktop row, the rest span a third
Content width is capped at 975px on desktop
